charts.evseProtocolNote: OCPP 1.6 has no EVSE concept (konnektorlar only); OCPP 2.1 treats EVSEs as first-class with N konnektorlar each.

settings.recaptchaSecretHint: Stored encrypted on the server. Leave blank to keep the joriy value.

settings.guestChargingEnabledDesc: Allow unauthenticated foydalanuvchilar to boshlash quvvatlash sessiyalari without an hisob.
settings.ocppStationConfigDescription: These values are sent to the stansiya after each BootNotification. OCPP 2.1 stansiyalar receive SetVariables buyruqlar. OCPP 1.6 stansiyalar receive ChangeConfiguration buyruqlar. Values of 0 are not pushed.
settings.ocppMeterValueIntervalHelp: How often the stansiya hisobotlar energiya readings during a transaction. Pushed as SampledDataCtrlr.TxUpdatedInterval (2.1) or MeterValueSampleInterval (1.6). Set to 0 to use stansiya firmware defaults.
settings.ocppClockAlignedIntervalHelp: Interval for clock-aligned meter value reporting at exact vaqt boundaries (e.g. 900 for every 15 minutes on the hour). Pushed as AlignedDataCtrlr.Interval (2.1) or ClockAlignedDataInterval (1.6). Set to 0 to disable.
settings.ocppSampledMeasurandsHelp: Comma-separated measurands reported during faol transactions. Pushed as SampledDataCtrlr.TxUpdatedMeasurands (2.1) or MeterValuesSampledData (1.6).
settings.ocppAlignedMeasurandsHelp: Comma-separated measurands reported at clock-aligned intervals. Pushed as AlignedDataCtrlr.Measurands (2.1) or MeterValuesAlignedData (1.6). Only sent when clock-aligned interval is greater than 0.
settings.ocppTxEndedMeasurandsHelp: Comma-separated measurands included in the final meter value snapshot when a transaction ends. Pushed as SampledDataCtrlr.TxEndedMeasurands (2.1) or StopTxnSampledData (1.6).
settings.ocppBootResponseDescription: These values are returned to the stansiya in the BootNotification response. The stansiya reads and applies them automatically.
settings.ocppHeartbeatIntervalHelp: How often the stansiya sends heartbeat messages to confirm it is still onlayn. Returned as the interval field in the BootNotification response.
settings.ocppCsmsConfigDescription: These sozlamalar control how the CSMS handles OCPP communication. They are not sent to stansiyalar.
settings.ocppConnectionTimeoutHelp: How long to wait for a stansiya to respond to a command before timing out.
settings.ocppResetRetriesHelp: Number of times to retry a Reset command if the stansiya does not respond.
settings.ocppApprovalRequiredHelp: When yoqilgan, new stansiyalar are placed in a kutilmoqda state until an operator approves them. When o‘chirilgan, stansiyalar are accepted automatically on first BootNotification.
settings.idlingDescription: Configure how long a transport vositasi can remain idle before idle fees boshlash accruing. The grace period delays billing but haydovchilar are notified immediately when idling starts.
settings.idleGracePeriodHelp: Set to 0 to boshlash idle fees immediately. haydovchilar are notified as soon as idling begins regardless of this sozlama.
settings.sessionDescription: Configure automatic cleanup of stale quvvatlash sessiyalari. sessiyalar with no activity beyond the timeout are marked as faulted. This handles cases where a stansiya loses quvvat and never sends a transaction end event.
settings.staleSessionTimeoutHelp: sessiyalar with no meter value updates for this duration are automatically closed. Set to 0 to disable automatic cleanup.
settings.pricingDescription: Configure vaqt-of-day narxlash behavior, split billing across tarif boundaries, and narxlash display on stansiya screens.
